sources.title: What are your support hours?
sources.excerpt: Our AI assistant is available 24/7. Human agents are available Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM UTC. Outside these hours, your message will be queued and an agent will respond on the next business day.

sources.title: How do I contact support?
sources.excerpt: You can contact support by clicking the chat widget in the bottom right corner of any page. Our AI assistant will help you immediately, and if needed, connect you with a human agent.

sources.title: Understanding Your Invoice
sources.excerpt: Breakdown of invoice sections and common billing questions.

sources.title: API Authentication Guide
sources.excerpt: Complete guide to API authentication, rate limits, and error handling.

sources.title: Can I cancel my subscription?
sources.excerpt: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > Billing. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period. No refunds are provided for partial periods.
